svg.title: Published design and a runnable file-checking example
svg.desc: The actual first page of the Research Architect white paper, an exact excerpt of the public file-checking example, and output from its five self-checks. The example uses invented records and was written for the portfolio; it is not private RA runtime code.
svg.text: def inspect_file(path: Path, expected_hash: str) -> str:
for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
